name: Beach sand
where: Tan sand mounds on the pond shore, west of the spawn

name: Quartz sand
where: White crystal clusters in the rocky highlands, about 22 m east

name: Iron ore
where: Dark rust-flecked rocks in the highlands, about 15 m east

name: Copper ore
where: Plain grey rocks in the highlands, about 25 m east. Look at one with your hand lens (F) to find out what it is

name: Plant oil
where: Sunflowers north-west of the spawn. Look at a sunflower seed with a compound microscope (F) to find the oil

name: Tungsten ore
where: Heavy grey rocks at the far end of the highlands, about 31 m east. Look at one with a high-quality microscope (F) to see what is inside

name: Resin
where: Amber-dripping stumps in the pine grove, north-east, about 25 m away
